title: Female borrowers who describe themselves as a 'hardworking entrepreneur' may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention being a widow may fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention being aged 60 or older may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who include a caption for the photo may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who explicitly identify a person in their photo may fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention their business is located in the city center may fund faster.
Female borrowers who provide highly specific inventory weights or regional details may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention a family member's positive loan repayment history may fund faster.
Pitches from women that specify the number of children, their ages, or the professional status of a spouse are associated with increased funding speed.
Pitches that detail specific business inputs, professional skills, concrete objectives, or economic and environmental rationales accelerate funding regardless of gender.
Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention securing the future of their family fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention sustaining business through past NWTF loans fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention their own previous loan repayment history fund faster.
